title: Currency, paper and textile: three industries, three federations
author: Editorial Desk
summary: The Currency and Coins, Kagaz Udyog and Vastrodyog federations.
body:
Three more of BMS's thirty-eight federations show the range of its work.

## Currency and coins

The **Bharatiya Currency and Coins Karamchari Mahasangh** represents employees of the mints and currency presses, who produce the nation's notes and coins. Security, skill and secrecy mark the work, and the issues include **wage structures, promotions and safety**.

## Paper

The **Bharatiya Kagaz Udyog Karamchari Mahasangh** represents workers in paper mills, which have been affected by raw material costs, imports and closure of older mills.

## Textiles

The **Bharatiya Vastrodyog Karmachari Mahasangh** represents workers in textile mills and related units. Textiles employ one of the largest workforces in manufacturing. Issues include **modernisation, job losses, export orders and wages** in powerloom clusters.

## The common point

These industries have long histories, deep skills and uncertain futures. BMS's guide is to seek policies that protect jobs while improving competitiveness.

A later post reports a delegation to the Textile Minister in September 2026.
